resources.string:
MigraineGuard reads steps, sleep, heart rate, exercise, distance, and calories from Health Connect to correlate lifestyle with migraine patterns. Optionally we can write exercise sessions you log here. Data stays on your device unless you enable Drive sync.

Also enable sharing in Samsung Health → Health Connect so Galaxy Watch data appears.

Sideloaded debug builds appear under Connected apps after the first successful permission request.
Track migraines, hydration, fitness, sleep, weather pressure, and food triggers — calmly.
